description: Shorti(쇼티) for a pasted TikTok, Reels or Shorts link, or a Shorti link, with «read this» or «이 영상 읽어줘». One video read second by second: what happens, what its viewers said and where, each shot's set-up, its views beside its maker's usual. `url`: the post's link or a Shorti link. Each second is a link that opens its page there. not_in_corpus: not read yet. `cursor`: a long page's next part.
